BrochureContent.Content:
Smith Harrington is delighted to present No. 15 Churchfield, Kentstown, Navan, Co. Meath to the market. This well-proportioned four-bedroom semi-detached home is ideally positioned within the popular residential development of Churchfield in Kentstown.

Kentstown is a highly convenient village location, situated approximately a 10-minute drive from Navan, which offers an extensive range of retail, leisure and educational facilities. The property also enjoys easy access to Drogheda, Ashbourne and Slane, together with convenient access to the M3 and M1 motorways, making it an excellent location for commuters. The village also benefits from regular public transport services, providing straightforward access to Dublin City Centre.

Built circa 2001 and extending to approximately 106.68 sq. m. / 1,148 sq. ft., the property offers spacious and versatile accommodation over two floors and would make an excellent family home.

The ground floor accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hall, spacious living room with bay window and a generous kitchen/dining room. Upstairs there are four bedrooms, including a master bedroom with en-suite, together with a family bathroom.

The property benefits from a C-rated BER, with an energy performance indicator of 186.52 kWh/m²/yr and offers an excellent opportunity for those seeking a spacious family home in a convenient and well-established residential location.
